name: Alpenrose
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The **Alpenrose Hotel** is located in a charming village in **Tirol, Austria**. The accommodation offers various room categories, a breakfast buffet, and half-board packages. The hotel features a wellness area with a sauna and steam bath, as well as a restaurant serving traditional regional cuisine. Unique features include its direct location at the **skibus stop** and easy access to nearby hiking trails. Guests can enjoy a peaceful setting with stunning views of the surrounding mountain landscape. The hotel also provides a ski storage room and secure bike storage.
